clips.send: A broke 20-something sends this to a friend who swears nothing works for them, in awe that one 30-minute session unlocked six figures for a 15-year-old.
clips.caption:
Kevin Trudeau says that even as a young teenager, he already knew people pulling in huge money - and he still couldn't do it himself.

His uncle, deep inside the secretive brotherhood that trained them both, told him the problem wasn't effort. It was an energetic block. So his uncle sat him down and ran a thirty-minute process on him to clear it.

Within a couple of weeks, Kevin says hundreds of thousands of dollars started coming in. He was fifteen years old.

He didn't call it luck. He called it a block removed.

What's blocking you right now that has nothing to do with how hard you work?
